{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales_df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv')

# Convert revenue from string to float, handling thousands separators
sales_df['revenue'] = sales_df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Filter out refunded orders
sales_df = sales_df[sales_df['status'] == 'completed']

# Check for missing or invalid customer_age
print("Customer age -1 count:", (sales_df['customer_age'] == -1).sum())

# Inspect the distribution of channels and customer segments
print("\nChannel distribution:")
print(sales_df['channel'].value_counts())

print("\nCustomer segment distribution:")
print(sales_df['customer_segment'].value_counts())

# Check if conversion rates are confounded by customer_segment
print("\nConversion rate by channel and customer segment:")
print(sales_df.groupby(['channel', 'customer_segment'])['converted'].mean())"}
